description_for_model: Flypost Ask provides read-only access to discover local events using the Flypost Discovery Protocol V1. Use GET /v1/events/near for radius-filtered, nearest-first local events with distance_mi when available, and GET /v1/events/{event_id} for a specific event. This surface is discovery-only and does not support event creation or modification.
description_for_human: Discover nearby local events through the Flypost Discovery Protocol.
